title: Cat models Christmas sweater and experiences an adorable fall while getting used to the outfit
description:
The purr-ecious star of this footage had no idea that this Christmas season would mark his journey to becoming a fashion icon.

"Watch my cat in his new Xmas PJs, and then me using a hair dryer on him," the filmer, Lindsey, told WooGlobe.

While the feline does not mind the hair dryer, it is the PJs that may remain an obstacle to his comfort for a while. Just a few seconds into wearing his new holiday-themed outfit, the kitty ends up taking an embarrassing fall.
